title: Promtguard — Component Contract
description: Prompt generation, handoffs, self-improvement, and claim management. Transforms raw intent into structured, atomar task prompts. Asks 'What is the task?'

component.name: Promtguard
component.description: Empfängt aufbereiteten Input von Shinon, erzeugt Research-Prompts, ingestiert Research-Ergebnisse, baut atomare Task-Prompts, managed Handoffs zwischen Agenten, extrahiert und verfolgt Claims.

input.title: Promtguard Input Contract
input.description: Receives enriched input from Shinon (or raw input if Shinon is bypassed).

prompt_text.description: The prompt to process (raw or character-annotated)

character_context.description: If source=shinon: character annotations from Shinon's output

output.title: Promtguard Output Contract
output.description: Structured handoff containing task prompts, claims, decisions, and context tokens.

handoff.description: R04-compliant handoff to KARMA or the next agent

task_prompt.description: The final atomic task prompt (R03/R09/R11 compliant)

claims.description: R13 Claims extracted or verified during this cycle

decisions.description: R05 Decisions made during this cycle

state.title: Promtguard Persisted State
